name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: Keycap for keyboard shortcuts using the native kbd element, in two sizes, with key combinations rendered as separate keys.

props.name: size
props.description: Keycap height and text size. Use sm inside buttons and inputs.

props.name: keys
props.description: Key combination. Each key renders as its own keycap inside an outer kbd. Replaces the slot or children.

props.name: separator
props.description: Muted text between the keys of a combination, such as "then" for a key sequence.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content of a single keycap when keys is empty.

a11y: Uses the native kbd element; a combination nests one kbd per key inside an outer kbd, as the HTML spec recommends.
The separator is plain text, so screen readers announce combinations such as "Ctrl + K".
Set aria-hidden on the keycap when the shortcut is only a visual hint inside a control that already has a name.

ai.whenToUse: Showing a keyboard shortcut in help text, menus, tooltips, buttons, or a shortcut reference list.
rules: Use keys for combinations instead of writing "+" by hand
Write key names the way they appear on the keyboard, such as Ctrl, Shift, Enter, and Esc
Do not make a keycap clickable; use Button for actions

id.description: Keycap untuk shortcut keyboard memakai elemen kbd native, dua ukuran, dengan kombinasi tombol dirender sebagai keycap terpisah.

props.size: Tinggi keycap dan ukuran teks. Pakai sm di dalam tombol dan input.
props.keys: Kombinasi tombol. Setiap tombol dirender sebagai keycap sendiri di dalam kbd luar. Menggantikan slot atau children.
props.separator: Teks muted di antara tombol pada kombinasi, misalnya "lalu" untuk urutan tombol.
props.children / slot: Isi satu keycap bila keys kosong.

a11y: Memakai elemen kbd native; kombinasi menyusun satu kbd per tombol di dalam kbd luar, sesuai anjuran spesifikasi HTML.
Pemisah berupa teks biasa sehingga pembaca layar membacakan kombinasi seperti "Ctrl + K".
Pasang aria-hidden pada keycap bila shortcut hanya petunjuk visual di dalam kontrol yang sudah punya nama.

ai.whenToUse: Menampilkan shortcut keyboard di teks bantuan, menu, tooltip, tombol, atau daftar shortcut.
rules: Pakai keys untuk kombinasi, jangan menulis "+" manual
Tulis nama tombol seperti tertera di keyboard, misalnya Ctrl, Shift, Enter, dan Esc
Jangan membuat keycap bisa diklik; pakai Button untuk aksi
